name: Your Spotify
description: Your Spotify is a self-hosted web app that tracks and displays statistics about your Spotify listening history, similar to Last.fm.

notes.text: During installation you must create a Spotify application at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard and provide its Client ID and Client Secret when prompted.

Spotify requires HTTPS for redirect URIs (except localhost). If you plan to use this behind a reverse proxy with TLS, enter your public HTTPS API URL when prompted during install so the correct redirect URI is registered.

The API endpoint is baked into the client build at install time. To change it later, update API_ENDPOINT and CLIENT_ENDPOINT in /opt/your_spotify/apps/server/.env, update the Redirect URI in the Spotify dashboard, then run the update function to rebuild the client and restart both services.
